summary: Grayscale Ethereum Staking ETF filed an 8-K to announce a proposed amendment to its trust agreement, enabling regular cash distributions of staking rewards to shareholders. The amendment, effective around August 7, 2026, requires quarterly conversion of staking consideration to cash and prompt distribution net of expenses. This is a routine operational and tax-compliance measure conforming to IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-31, not a special situation. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor is mentioned. No risk-arb angle exists; the filing is a standard current report.
